trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut: finish the story, the 100% checklist, and every side goal in this guide. Expect around 200 hours in total.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this one unlocks naturally within your first hour.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock automatically, so just play the main missions through to the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every story trophy, it unlocks on its own as you play the main missions — nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the main story missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. There are five chapters in total, so one more chapter after this one ends the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This gold trophy is the payoff for completing the last mission of the fifth and final chapter.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it comes up as you play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story missions cannot be missed, so just keep playing the campaign.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It unlocks as part of the story, in order with the other mission trophies.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Play the story missions in order and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies; it unlocks as the campaign reaches it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story — the checklist appears there, and everything you did earlier already counts. It is the longest grind: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 42 shooting-range gold medals and all 42 drone time trials. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, so you can skip the hardest leftovers.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. The game counts 397 in total across stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, so mix types as you travel instead of grinding one spot. The 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf, basketball, shooting ranges and drone races. One try each is enough — you do not need to win.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are found across Leonida; practise the weapon types you are weakest with first, since every single challenge must be gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. The 42 drone time trials count toward 100% too, so run them while you are already at each location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 races in total and the 100% checklist wants 30 won, so keep entering new events rather than repeating one you already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and win the head-to-head challenge he offers — bring your best rod and bait.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Arcades are scattered around Vice City — pick a machine, play it through to the end once, and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand until his last job is done — side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's whole mission strand, from his first job to his last.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends with one last job — finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore — finish eight full strands, not just eight single missions. The five side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with one final job — finish it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, with Jason and Lucia. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged as such: the first spot is Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house, offered after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1. Do it before Chapter 1 ends, or it is gone for this playthrough. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18, but the trophy needs all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at a one-of-a-kind animal — track it down and take it. Bret also has 15 Target Deck objectives that count toward 100%.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting well past this trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, vehicles and spots of interest with the WAiNK app as you travel — it doubles as progress toward the 200 base-model vehicles the 100% checklist wants.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are scattered goals across activities and the open world; the 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so keep going after this one pops.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the police to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level alive between them — do not let it clear.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new you meet.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a busy fight and drop five enemies before it ends — a gang hideout is a good place to try.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off with it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos appear at military sites — grab one and fight with it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The eight large vaults unlock with the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' in Chapter 4 — five of them earn this trophy, and all eight count toward 100%.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open and get away before the police close in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the map — driving through them counts, so sweep the state region by region until the map is filled in.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total for the 100% checklist; one per gang is enough here.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed as of 19 Nov 2026 — guide writers are still pinning it down, so check the cited guides for updates before hunting for it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed as of 19 Nov 2026 — the trophy's description is the only solid lead so far, so do not trust unverified claims.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the alley and escape with them.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train strength with both characters until each stat is maxed out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Play normally and the count climbs — crimes, robberies and mayhem all feed it, so this one comes with time.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned it down yet, so do not trust unverified claims.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Something strange happens out in Leonida. The method is still unconfirmed as of 19 Nov 2026 — it appears tied to one of the game's odd world events, which players are still mapping.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; the precise conditions are still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills through your contacts until the total hits $250,000 — the 100% checklist wants the same amount.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — spending adds up across every shop, so it comes naturally by the endgame.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida; save up and buy every one.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you find — ten registrations earn the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
